Class TerraformExporter

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.export.TerraformExporter
public class TerraformExporter extends Object
Renders a DeploymentPlan produced by the Deployment Wizard into Infrastructure-as-Code (HCL) for the Equinix Terraform provider.

The exporter only emits the resource types the plan actually contains and keeps attributes faithful to the fields the plan provides; it does not invent provider attributes that cannot be sourced from the plan. The generated HCL is intended as a readable, version-controllable starting point for terraform plan / apply.

Resource mapping:

  • PlannedCloudRouter → resource "equinix_fabric_cloud_router"
  • PlannedConnection (provider connections and backbone links) → resource "equinix_fabric_connection"
  • PlannedRoutingProtocol → resource "equinix_fabric_routing_protocol"

Customer inputs the plan deliberately leaves unresolved (the cloud authorization key, and the DOT1Q VLAN tag when not yet known) become variable blocks — the authorization key marked sensitive — referenced from the connection's Z-side, so the generated configuration is complete without ever fabricating or inlining a secret. A BGP routing protocol on a connection that also carries a DIRECT protocol is emitted with depends_on on the DIRECT resource, because Fabric requires DIRECT to exist before BGP on the same connection. The Fabric-mandated notifications block is emitted on every Cloud Router and connection — backbone links included — with every recipient the plan carries, and a planned connection's redundancy group/priority becomes a connection-level redundancy block.

Not emitted: Equinix provider credentials (supply them via the standard provider configuration), and any physical colocation the wider design may assume — the Equinix Terraform provider has no cabinet or cross-connect resources, so those cannot be expressed in HCL at all.

This class is stateless and thread-safe; a single instance may be reused.

  • Method Details

    • export

      public String export(DeploymentPlan plan)
      Exports the given deployment plan as Equinix Terraform provider HCL.

      The output is a complete document but not immediately appliable: before terraform apply, the caller must configure the Equinix provider's credentials and supply a value for each generated input variable — the per-connection cloud authorization key (sensitive) and DOT1Q VLAN tag, exactly the customer inputs DeploymentPlan.getRequiredInputs() enumerates. The generated header comment repeats this.

      Parameters:
      plan - the deployment plan to export; must not be null
      Returns:
      an HCL document. Resources are emitted in dependency order (cloud routers, then connections, then routing protocols), and later resources reference earlier ones via Terraform resource expressions.
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if plan is null
